summary: Land the shared plan to 1.0 (docs/PLAN_TO_1_0.md) and the audit that keeps it honest (tools/plan-audit.mjs, test:plan)

coordination.notes: The plan is the bookkeeping surface for parallel sessions: 100 increments in 12 lanes, each naming its files, commands, expected output and dependencies, with a status marker per line that ships in the increment's own commit. It complements this ledger rather than replacing it: a claim records who holds what; the plan records what there is to hold and in what order. The audit checks every named path and dependency against the tree (three states: present, absent, awaiting another increment) so a stale plan fails the build. Written against main ae0e57a9; the audit of the previous draft found seven wrong claims about the tree (section 9 of the plan lists each with the command that found it), including that rewrite/remove-2d deletes portraits.ts, which the previous draft proposed extending.
